name: API Orchestrator - Sample: Shopify
description: Shopify Storefront GraphQL sample via mock.shop: product listing, detail, collections and search, working out of the box.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Sample: Shopify installs a Shopify Storefront GraphQL sample using the public mock.shop endpoint — product listing, detail, collections and search — that works out of the box to demonstrate GraphQL endpoints and response mirroring. Requires api_orchestrator, api_orchestrator_integration_samples and api_orchestrator_mirror. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
